headline: Infineon has completed its purchase of C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based company that makes power-control chips for AI data centres.
score_reason: Kept at the pool level: the closing of a deal announced on 24 Aug 2026, with no price given.
importance_line: C2i's Bengaluru engineers join Infineon and AI data-centre operators may get better power-control chips from it, but the deal was announced in August, no price was given and the benefits are Infineon's own description.
summary: Infineon, the German chipmaker, announced on 5 Oct 2026 that it has completed its acquisition of C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based company whose software-defined controllers and power stages manage how electricity reaches processors in AI data centres. The deal was first announced on 24 Aug 2026; Infineon says the C2i team joins its Power Systems division to develop more efficient power delivery for AI servers, and neither announcement gives a price.
notes: Pool item is Bisinfotech's relay of Infineon's own press release; credited to Infineon and linked to its release, which was readable. The completion is new on 5 Oct 2026; the deal itself was announced 24 Aug 2026.
